source.notes: No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Genuine ICSE 2025 board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library bundle 'ICSE-MainExamination2025.zip'. Printed code 'T25 521' in the footer; 'This Paper consists of 16 printed pages'; PDF page numbers equal printed page numbers. Maximum Marks 80, Time allowed Two hours (plus 15 minutes reading time). No session is printed on the paper, so session is null. Section A (40 marks) is compulsory: Question 1 has fifteen 1-mark MCQ/assertion-reason items (one [15] bracket for the whole question); Question 2 (i) has six 1-mark fill-in-the-blanks under one [6] bracket, each extracted separately with 1 mark (SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS). All other entries are the printed sub-questions (i), (ii), (iii) with their own printed mark brackets; lettered parts (a), (b), (c) that share one bracket are kept together in one entry because no per-part marks are printed. Section B prints 'Attempt any four questions from this Section' and offers six 10-mark questions (4-9); all six are extracted, so the pack's marks total (100) intentionally exceeds maxMarks (80). No internal 'OR' choice, so choiceGroup is null throughout. Figures, graphs, circuit diagrams and the table in Q1 (xiv) are not reproduced; affected entries are flagged. Cognitive-level tags are not printed on this paper.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.
